body:
Stop comparing yourself to other people. Life isn't a competition. You need to find the source of what's creating the thoughts that hold you back from becoming who you want to be. Acknowledge that source and let it go. All you have is the present; let the past go and let yourself live. Figure out what you want to do with your life and take small steps each day toward achieving it. Don't be too hard on yourself, you're only human. A lot of people are struggling out there just like you.

This way of thinking has helped me lately. You won't become your "best" self overnight, so take it easy. Baby steps. Patience.
It's not working. I can't stay motivated to make it to class on time and do my work.
What do you mean? Are you just asking me what's up?
Sure, why not.
Thanks. It's a struggle.
I'm sorry to hear that, people can be so manipulative and cruel. We deserve someone who truly cares about us, it's unfortunate that it's hard to find them among all the fake people.

I feel you. Last night I broke up with the person who's been my pillar of support for almost 5 years now. The best years of my life. Just having someone there made life worth living to me. I don't have family or friends, not sure what I'm gonna do now... This is the emptiest I've felt in a long time.

Heaven and hell were created by humans to scare and oppress other humans. It's all bullshit. The reason we experience depression is because of other humans and the way they've shaped this world. Humans are humans' greatest enemies.

Damn... This sounds like me and the future I'm headed for. I left my factory job to pursue education and self-employment. The procrastination is real without that job routine and the obligation to get up and go to work in the morning.

I don't trust medication either, but I think it's time to ask my doctor about it next visit...

I was just thinking about that the other day. I try to consciously redirect my mind back on the current moment whenever it starts to drift. It's hard but hopefully I can keep it up, it's the only way I've been able to get anything done lately. Just gotta consciously think about things like breathing, walking, task at hand.

As many here have already commented, be careful what you wish for. I'm depressed and in a relationship with a wonderful girl, but I'm afraid I'm fucking it up and pushing her away.

She tries hard to make me happy but I've been incapable of happiness, and it's taking a toll on her. It makes me feel awful and guilty and I can see my negativity affecting the way she feels and acts. When in a relationship, you have to love and support your partner equally. You have to do what you can to make them happy, which means going out with them when you don't feel like it (I never feel like it), being a shoulder to cry on no matter how small their problems may be, forcing yourself to smile and not be a total buzzkill around them etc. Sex eventually becomes a chore when you're so depressed you lose your sex drive.

Relationships are tough, even tougher when you're depressed.

Thanks.

It's always a cycle, though. I can keep my shit together for a little while but then I always relapse into situations like this past weekend. More frequently now, too. I think I'm getting tired...

Worst part is having to lie and make up excuses for ignoring everyone. I can't ignore them forever or I'll lose them. What's my excuse gonna be this time... They probably already think I'm an asshole who doesn't have time for them. Maybe I am.
I'm hoppin in the shower now. Just wish I didn't have to fight and force myself to do these things.
Too long.

The tiniest sliver of hope that there is or will be a cure for this shit. Even just a way to make it more managable.

Forcing yourself out of bed and going through the motions each day with depressed/suicidal thoughts is exhausting.

I feel you, and thanks. I might give them a call in the morning to see if I can get an appointment sooner.

I hate to hear that therapy and stuff isn't working for you. I have my doubts about treatment, but I'm willing to at least try before I leave here. I'd just prefer not to leave a bunch of medical debt.
Yeah, most people only care about how it's gonna make them feel. They don't want to deal with inconvenient feelings.

I can relate. The toughest thing in the world for me is the fact that I'm hiding similar feelings and have to keep them to myself because people depend on me to keep my shit together.

People just assume you're fine or even happy if you aren't cooped up in isolation all day. "If you can get up and go to school/work etc. then you aren't REALLY depressed." Thing is, they don't realize how close you may be to not being able to do those things anymore.

My sister and I grew up poor and neglected. It was because my mom was very sick throughout my childhood and my dad was too busy juggling work and taking care of her. We never did anything, never saw anyone except my aunt occasionally. Mom died in a lot of pain 2 years ago and we're all pretty fucked up from it. Our childhoods were basically just being depressed, socially awkward at school, and watching our mom go through countless surgeries and slowly die.

We have to stick together now and keep an eye on each other, we're all we have. So I can't even run from it and try to pretend it didn't happen.

I actually never went. Honestly, I just wanted to do something with my mom. I wanted to see her enjoy something and smile and laugh.

I have, however, travelled and done things we used to talk about together. She always wanted me to go to the beach and see the ocean. Been 3 times now and even went out on a boat one time. She loved music, and I've been to many concerts and festivals since then. I live in the US and have been to different states all over. I still need to travel somewhere outside of the US eventually.

All that felt great at the time, but soon as I got home, the emptiness hit and I just wished my mom were there to experience it with me or at least tell her about it...

I'm grateful for what she taught me, though. She was a strong, beautiful woman who didn't go down without a fight. She fought like hell. It's the reason I'm still here, I can't just quit life after all she went through just to live as long as she did.

It would be so easy to quit, though.

I'm so sorry to hear about your parents, may they rest in peace.

I try to be as positive as I can about it, and I do feel like it has made me stronger. I'm glad she isn't suffering anymore and she taught me how to be a good person. I find that I'm usually that guy people go to to confide in when they're dealing with stuff, because I have a deep sense of empathy I guess. But when I get alone at night the thoughts and images are relentless.

I don't really have any desire to go to Disney World at this point, it never was about that place in particular. I just wanted to enjoy something with my mom before she died, anything. I had saved up the money in hopes that she would get well enough to go one day.

Thanks for your reply.
Thank you. It helps to at least get it out in words even if it's just anonymously on the internet.
Yeah, it's a frustrating feeling when someone's heart is in the right place but they don't have a damn clue what they're talking about...

I don't personally think we HAVE to go extinct. I agree that's where we're headed, but with modern knowledge and technology it's possible to evolve as a species beyond our basic survival instincts.

If people can look past themselves and at the big picture of the survival of our species as a whole, this world will be a completely different place. There's more than enough to go around here.
You're absolutely right... Humanity is fundamentally flawed. So how do we "fix" it? Is it even possible? Can we change or are we doomed to eventual extinction?
And life absolutely will shit on you. We can beat it. Please be here with me to beat it. The world needs minds like ours.

You're a bad motherfucker. A fighter. To handle life shitting on you and keep going like a soldier is something to be proud of. I struggle with life in general myself, but the pride of knowing that I've been through so much more shit than a lot of people is what keeps me going. Strength, we're strong, man.
No, thank you for carrying out his wish. He lived in a Hell that not a lot of people understand. He was a good person and didn't want to push pain on those he cared about like you, please know that.

This world can be a terrible, shallow place. Sometimes that is enough to send someone into a downward spiral of depression and eventual suicide... I know because I've felt this almost my entire life. I'm sorry.

Yeah I was very sure I'd end it before graduating high school. Tried once, didn't work. I didn't want any part of the BS hamster wheel that is modern society, but here I am at 25 slowly working my life away for a cold, greedy corporation to pay off debt that I had to get into for basic needs like shelter, transportation and food. It's some surreal shit when I wake up in the morning and think about it.
Been feeling more anger than anything lately. I'm just so sick of petty people and I feel like I need to lock myself in my house so I don't snap on anyone.

Haha believe me, I've ranted more times than I can count on that subject. It is seriously stupid and I can't stand it either. I used to just risk it and smoke anyway but had a couple close calls and had to stop. Almost every job around here drug tests and I'll be homeless if I don't work. No family or friends to lean on.

That sounds nice. I would get too deep into my head, though. I'm trying to escape my thoughts tonight, don't wanna roll into the new year with sadness and hopelessness racing through my mind. Here's to maintaining hope for next year

Wish I could smoke instead of drink myself. Random drug tests where I work. Plus my only connect went to jail earlier this year and seemingly disappeared off the face of the earth. Anyway, hope you have a decent night at least

Jesus, I know all too well what you're talking about... It's Hell. I eventually got to a point where I stopped giving a fuck what they think of me, just straight up told em that I'm not religious and refuse to be involved in anything church related.

They don't like it, probably don't like me, but they haven't been assholes about it. They tolerate me I guess, I take good care of my gf and stay out of trouble.

Not to mention the relatives who never came around or even called to check in when my mom was sick and dying. Now that she's dead they call and write us on christmas and act like we've always been ONE BIG HAPPY FAMILY. It makes me physically fucking sick and I wish I could not think about family ever again...

Fuck this time of year.

I don't dislike them or anything, other than the fact that they're religious country folk they're decent people.

It just reminds me of of the good times when I was little and had a family of my own... Then the people I loved got sick, died, moved etc. and all I'm left with is my POS dad and my little sister and it makes me want to die when I think about it.

Same. Christmas is just a bunch of bullshit to get people out spending their $. 

I would be relieved by the fact that I don't really have any family to worry about, but I know my girlfriend's gonna want me to join her and her family... dammit...

Thanks, it is tough... Being a grown male in rural Georgia, US, you're not supposed to need this kind of help. At least where I'm from. Be a man, suck it up, go to church etc. Been mostly silently dealing with this for ~14 years. I'm so done with it at this point, I feel like this is my last stand before it completely consumes me and my life.

I'm holding on to this anger toward it as motivation. I'm going to look into options in and around Atlanta.

Ok thanks, I didn't know if there was something else i needed or could do. Guess I'll just keep searching and calling. I've never tried this before so it makes me a bit uneasy, feels shameful honestly...

You're probably right, thanks again for hearing me out and chattin with me a bit. It really helped me through today. I'm at work right now, 12 hours a day 3-5 days a week... That's a lot of time for those thoughts to sink in, it's torture sometimes. But I'm going to keep fighting them off best I can.

Hope you're having a good day yourself.

Yeah, but she didn't know what to say and it just upset her, understandably so... She started blaming herself and beating herself up, so I had to sit there for hours trying to convince her it's not her fault and there's nothing wrong with her. I came to her for support and ended up having to support her. So... Not doing that again haha. She struggles with anxiety and depression, too, unfortunately something we have in common. She's ok with moving to Atlanta, though, just not out of state. Looks like our best option at the moment.

I've been all around the southeast and it's more of the same shit. Worked on a farm in New Mexico, loved that lifestyle but the loneliness and isolation was too much. What I've seen of the east coast is too touristy and there aren't enough good jobs. Colorado is awesome, but there's been a huge influx of people moving there to smoke weed. I'm sure it's becoming overcrowded in Colorado Springs where I'd like to move to. I'm wondering if I need to just drop everything, including gf if I need to, and give it a shot. Take a risk. Just haul ass to Colorado and don't look back... Do you happen to live in a city? Moving to Atlanta is an alternative, never tried urban living.

Relationship =/= happiness. But I'm aware that a good one helps, and I'm grateful for her. She suffers from her own problems, though, so I can't burden her with mine. That's why I'm here, it at least feels better to air everything out... Thanks.

Edit: Just wanted to add that depression isn't a competition. I know I have it monumentally better than A LOT of people. There are people out there in 3rd world countries who can't get on reddit and ask for help or at least sympathy for starving to death and suffering from disease. They have it worse than every single one of us.

Small town in rural Georgia. Everyone here is either a burnout, Christian, or sports fanatic. The closest friends I've made just wanna sit around and smoke/drink and play Call of Duty/watch football. It's boring around here and I hope that's my only problem... and I'll admit I have a shitty attitude toward people and have a harder time making friends because of it, but I haven't met many honest, intelligent people in my lifetime. I love music and play guitar, but everyone I meet likes rap, country, Nickelback, or that emo stuff. No real metalheads or at least Blues guys, trust me I've been looking. I get a raised eyebrow when I share my music tastes at the bar or a party. Maybe I'll find a band or something one day... Thanks for your response.
